messages:
rafael-m: Hey payroll — I converted from contractor to full-time on 2026-02-10. My last contractor invoice paid 2/5 was paid without state withholding, but my first FT paycheck 2/20 withheld NJ. I split time between NJ and PA in Jan-Feb. Can payroll advise whether wages need retro allocation for state withholding?

jen-people-ops: @rafael-m thanks for flagging. @samir-payroll can you take a look? We have the hire docs in HR.

samir-payroll: Hey Rafael — congrats on the conversion. Quick checklist: send employee ID, last4 SSN, dates you performed work in PA vs NJ, and your contractor invoice dates. Well pull the ledger and check if any employer-side withholding or reporting needs correction.

rafael-m: Emp ID 50321, last4 2345. I worked in PA 2026-01-01 to 2026-01-31, NJ 2026-02-01 to 2026-02-09 (contractor days), then FT NJ from 2026-02-10. Contractor invoice for Jan (paid 2/5) was via contractor vendor.

payroll-bot: Created ticket PR-2026-210: "Contractor->FT midyear state allocation - Rafael M (50321)" assigned to samir-payroll.

samir-payroll: Thanks. Two things to watch: 1) Contractor earnings paid via 1099 vendor are not on W-2, so we won't reclassify those into W-2 wages. 2) W-2 will reflect FT wages only (from 2/10 forward). For state tax purposes, only wages on W-2 are subject to withholding. If you have NJ withholding on FT wages and PA has reciprocal or withholding rules, well confirm residency and work-site rules.

emily-hr: Adding that Rafaels onboarding paperwork shows NJ as home state starting 2026-02-10; PA was temporary contract location. I attached the contractor agreement to the ticket.

samir-payroll: Given contractor pay was handled through vendor (1099), payroll won't shift that pay to W-2. If you paid estimated taxes on contractor earnings or need help for PA state filings, payroll can provide an earnings report and letter explaining the split (useful for state returns). If any taxes were incorrectly withheld on the FT paycheck we will correct via payroll adjustment or W-2c if needed.

rafael-m: Understood. My CPA asked if we can provide an employer statement showing FT wages and withholding dates for 2026. Can you provide that?

samir-payroll: Yes — we'll generate an employer earnings/withholding statement and upload to the ticket within 5 business days. If we find a withholding error on FT runs, we'll note corrective actions and whether a W-2c will be issued.

jen-people-ops: Action items confirmed. Rafael - confirm any estimated tax payments you made for Jan contractor income; samir - post statement. Will check back here once done. :white_check_mark:
